title: Selected olfactory and mushroom-body anatomy from MaleCNS v1.0
attribution: MaleCNS collaboration: FlyEM / HHMI Janelia, University of Cambridge, MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, and Google Research.
selection: All right-soma DM1_lPN, VA1d_adPN, PPL101, PPL103, MBON11 and MBON12 plus the first 15 right-soma KCg-m rows sorted by bodyId. This is a small illustrative anatomical subset, not selected by a measured connection or driver expression.
source_skeleton_units: 8 nm; coordinates multiplied by 0.008 to express micrometres
display_changes: Mesh decimation; fixed camera projection; color coding by annotated cell class; white background. Skeleton coordinates and parent links unchanged. No synthetic neural branches, tracer paths, or synapses added.
what_is_not_shown: A registration of the team light-sheet data
Connectivity verification among these selected cells
A complete population or complete connectome
supplied_reference: The user-supplied Neuroglancer scene was MaleCNS v0.9. This figure explicitly uses the later official v1.0 release. Selected scene IDs are not treated as driver identities.
driver_note: TH and GH146 are driver contexts, not identities inferred from this atlas. The team identifies the recorded TH preparation as 5137;TH (TH-GFP, mCD8::GFP membrane labeling). The separate GH146 preparation uses UAS-GCaMP6f. The exact parental cross and progeny genotype for the recorded TH preparation remain to be documented.
reconstruction_rendering: A scientific rendering of published EM-derived neuron centerlines and neuropil surface geometry; not an AI-generated image.
geometry_preparation_tool: fast-simplification quadric-error mesh decimation; surface context only
reproduction: The distributed package was extracted and run independently; both generated raster files were byte-identical.
